enum SspUpdateEventType {
SSP_UPDATE_EVENT_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED = 0;

// Item-level offline consistency validation failed and unlink completed.
SSP_UPDATE_EVENT_TYPE_ASYNC_ITEM_CONSISTENCY_VALIDATION_FAILED_UNLINKED = 1;

// Model-level offline consistency validation failed and unlink completed.
SSP_UPDATE_EVENT_TYPE_ASYNC_MODEL_CONSISTENCY_VALIDATION_FAILED_UNLINKED = 2;

// Auto-enroll successfully linked all target models.
SSP_UPDATE_EVENT_TYPE_AUTO_ENROLL_LINKED = 3;

// ERP/in-house system directly requested unlink through Open API.
SSP_UPDATE_EVENT_TYPE_OPEN_API_LINKAGE_UNLINKED = 4;

// Seller quick-unlink completed without review.
SSP_UPDATE_EVENT_TYPE_SELLER_QUICK_UNLINKED = 5;

// Seller unlink review was approved and unlink completed.
SSP_UPDATE_EVENT_TYPE_SELLER_UNLINK_REVIEW_APPROVED_UNLINKED = 6;

// Seller unlink review expired and unlink completed.
SSP_UPDATE_EVENT_TYPE_SELLER_UNLINK_REVIEW_EXPIRED_UNLINKED = 7;

// SSP profile or SSP/CSSP relationship change caused unlink.
SSP_UPDATE_EVENT_TYPE_SSP_LINKAGE_CHANGE_UNLINKED = 8;

// Item entered SSP blacklist and its linkage was removed.
SSP_UPDATE_EVENT_TYPE_ITEM_SSP_BLACKLIST_UNLINKED = 9;

// Seller Education incorrect linkage expired and was automatically removed.
SSP_UPDATE_EVENT_TYPE_SELLER_EDU_EXPIRED_UNLINKED = 10;
}
